how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply online for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Apply Online 2026 by following the steps below.
Visit the official UPSSSC website, upsssc.gov.in.
Go to the "Live Advertisement" segment on the homepage and locate Advertisement No. 17-Pariksha/2026.
Login/authenticate using your PET-2025 registration number and the OTP sent to your registered mobile number/email.
Review the personal details, category, and other information carried forward automatically from your PET-2025 application.
Select the post(s) you wish to apply for; posts not selected will not be considered.
Enter your educational qualification and preferential eligibility details, along with board/university name, year of passing, certificate/roll number, and marks.
View your photo and signature, carried forward automatically from PET-2025 (these cannot be edited).
Fill in other details, including preferential qualification (Yes/No), and your address as recorded in PET-2025.
Read the declaration carefully, tick all points if you agree, enter the verification code, and click Save and Submit.
Pay the prescribed fee through Credit Card/Debit Card/Internet Banking/UPI or an SBI e-challan.
Download and print your submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Vacancy 2026 must note the following dates carefully. No application or fee will be accepted after the last date. The notification specifically states that candidates must reconcile their fee payment through the bank by 29-09-2026, or at the latest within 7 days thereafter, i.e., by 06-10-2026. Applicants can also revise permissible details in their application form during this same window.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1251 posts of Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari have been notified across the general recruitment category and the special selection category, as shown below. Both categories of posts are Level-5 (Pay Matrix, minimum ₹29,200 – maximum ₹92,300) and are a mix of permanent and temporary positions. The notification records all horizontal reservation categories as "00" for the Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari (Special Selection) post.

rows.category: One Arm Affected / Dwarfism / Acid Attack Victims (O.A./Dw./A.A.V.)

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil all conditions below to be eligible for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Recruitment 2026. Must have appeared in the Preliminary Eligibility Test 2025 (PET-2025) and hold a valid PET-2025 score card issued by the Commission. Must not have scored zero or a negative absolute/normalized score in PET-2025. Must hold the mandatory educational qualification (see below) by the last date of application, 29-09-2026.

rows.requirement: Intermediate examination with the Biology group from the Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad, Uttar Pradesh, or an examination recognized as equivalent (10+2) by the Government, AND a two-year Pashudhan Prasar Diploma course from a Veterinary University/Veterinary College established by law
Knowledge of Hindi in the Devanagari script

Other things being equal, preference is given to candidates who: (i) served at least 2 years in the Territorial Army, or (ii) hold an NCC 'B' certificate, or (iii) served 15 years of continuous active duty in the Remount Veterinary Corps as a Veterinary Dresser (Grade 1/2) and passed UP High School with Science or Agriculture as a subject, or an equivalent recognized examination

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must have attained 21 years of age and must not have exceeded 40 years of age as on 1 July of the calendar year in which the vacancies are advertised for direct recruitment. Upper age limit relaxation is admissible to candidates of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and such other categories as notified by the Government from time to time, "to the extent specified" - the notification does not state the exact number of relaxation years for these categories. Serving employees of State Government services get a 5-year relaxation in the maximum age limit, as per Government Order No. 2-E.M./2001-Ka-4-2013 dated 27 August 2013. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application-stage fee for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Recruitment 2026 is the same across categories, consisting only of an online processing charge. Fee for candidates in the Dependent of Freedom Fighter, Ex-Serviceman, Women, Divyangjan, and Outstanding Sportsperson categories is payable as per their original base category listed above. A separate examination fee for the main exam itself will be payable only by candidates who are shortlisted for the main exam, and this will need to be paid before downloading the main exam admit card. The exact amount of this separate main exam fee is not specified in this notification.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Salary
content_sections.text: The Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari post carries a pay of Level-5 in the pay matrix, with a minimum of ₹29,200 and a maximum of ₹92,300. This applies to both the general recruitment and special selection categories of the post. The notification does not specify the exact gross monthly salary, allowances, or in-hand pay.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to the Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari post is made on the basis of a written examination, as per the UP Pashupalan Vibhag, Pashudhan Prasar evam Kukkut Vikas Seva Niyamawali, 2002 (as amended). The written exam pattern is detailed below. The exam is objective/multiple-choice type, with a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). Each question carries 1 mark. Negative marking applies: 25 percent (¼) of the marks prescribed for a question is deducted for each wrong answer. Shortlisting of candidates to sit the main exam itself is based on the normalized PET-2025 score, category-wise, up to 15 times the number of notified vacancies (including all candidates tied at the cut-off normalized score).

faq.question: Q1. What is UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the recruitment notification (Advertisement No. 17-Pariksha/2026) released by the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission for online applications to the Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Mukhya Pariksha (Main Exam), for 1251 posts under the Animal Husbandry Directorate.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1251 vacancies are notified - 1248 posts under general recruitment and 3 posts under special selection.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to complete registration, pay the fee, and submit the online application is 29-09-2026. Fee reconciliation and form correction can be done until 06-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari?
faq.answer: Candidates need an Intermediate (10+2) qualification with the Biology group, plus a two-year Pashudhan Prasar Diploma from a veterinary university/college established by law, along with knowledge of Hindi in the Devanagari script.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 21 years and not more than 40 years of age as on 1 July of the calendar year in which the vacancies are advertised. Age relaxation applies for SC/ST and other notified categories, though the exact relaxation period is not specified in this notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All categories (Unreserved, OBC, SC, ST) pay a total fee of ₹25 (application fee ₹0 + online processing fee ₹25) at the application stage. A separate main exam fee applies later only to shortlisted candidates; its amount is not specified in this notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online at upsssc.gov.in by logging in with their PET-2025 registration number and OTP, filling in the required details, uploading/confirming qualification details, and paying the fee before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a written examination of 100 objective/MCQ questions worth 100 marks, to be completed in 2 hours, with negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari?
faq.answer: The post carries Level-5 pay in the pay matrix, ranging from a minimum of ₹29,200 to a maximum of ₹92,300. Other salary components are not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Who is eligible to apply for the UPSSSC Pashudhan Prasar Adhikari Main Exam 2026?
faq.answer: Only candidates who appeared in PET-2025, hold a valid PET-2025 score card, did not score zero/negative in PET-2025, and possess the mandatory educational qualification by the last date of application are eligible to apply.
